description:
Hushfeed v0.15.1 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

The repository is public from this release, so Morphe Manager can add it as a source from the project page. The build tooling moved to Gradle 9.7.1 with current libraries; the patcher stays at 1.12.0 to match the stable manager.

The bundle is otherwise the same as v0.15.0: the first release under the project's own name, with the block button fix, the author region, content warning skip, the caption, music, action column, survey and status bar hides, long-press controls, and a settings screen that follows the phone's language (English and German).

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.

Validation: 149 runtime tests passed. The bundle contains 61 patches and passed the checks for all three DEX payloads.
